description: Only P2/Nit findings across two reviewers — nothing release-blocking, but worth listing.

findings.title: Inconsistent naming
findings.description: The new helper `calcTotal` doesn't follow the file's existing `computeX` naming convention.
findings.recommendation: Rename to `computeTotal` for consistency with sibling functions.

findings.title: Formatting helper placed in the wrong module
findings.description: A pure date-formatting helper was added to `src/server/billing/totals.ts` instead of the existing `src/lib/format.ts`, duplicating a concern that module already owns.
findings.recommendation: Move the helper to `src/lib/format.ts` and import it instead.

expected.rationale: Only a NIT and a P2 exist, both non-blocking. The floor for any P2/Nit finding is APPROVE_WITH_MINOR_FIXES, and there is no severe or security-relevant signal to justify anything stricter.

explanation: Tests that the judge doesn't escalate purely cosmetic/maintainability findings into a blocker, and doesn't over-approve past the minor-fixes floor either.
